result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked continental crosswalks and paved sidewalks. While the environment is functional, it lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and features a cluttered corner with multiple utility poles that may impede movement.

hazards.name: Pole placement
hazards.description: Utility and sign poles are located at the corner apex, which may slightly narrow the accessible path for pedestrians with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corner of the intersection near the street signs

hazards.name: Missing pedestrian signal
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal head is visible for the foreground crosswalk, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection crossing

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals and improve safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and increase the visibility of pedestrians to approaching drivers.

result.summary: The urban environment features a wide signalized intersection with multi-story mixed-use buildings and continuous sidewalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like signals and marked crosswalks are present, the roadway includes embedded trolley tracks and lacks physical traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks embedded in the roadway can be slippery when wet and pose a tripping hazard or a risk to bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway

hazards.name: Wide Intersection
hazards.description: The width of the intersection increases pedestrian exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Use continental or ladder markings to make the crossing more visible to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Provide a physical barrier between cyclists and motor vehicle traffic to improve safety and comfort.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features marked continental crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides of the street. However, the intersection lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and has sightline obstructions due to parked vehicles near the crossing.

hazards.name: Restricted Sightlines
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection block the view between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb on the left side of the street near the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks visible dedicated pedestrian signal heads, creating uncertainty for crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light pole on the right corner.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A ladder and construction equipment are placed on the sidewalk, narrowing the path for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk on the right side of the image, leaning against the building.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and prevent illegal parking near the crosswalk.

result.summary: The street environment provides continuous sidewalks on both sides but lacks any marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control devices. The presence of embedded tram tracks and parked vehicles along the curbs creates significant physical and visual hazards for pedestrians attempting to cross the roadway.

hazards.name: Tram tracks
hazards.description: Embedded metal rails in the roadway surface can cause tripping or trap the wheels of strollers and wheelchairs.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway running longitudinally

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked crossing points, forcing pedestrians to cross in an unprotected manner.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible street segment

hazards.name: Sight line obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars along both sides of the street block the visibility between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbsides on both left and right
